subtitle: Lesson 16 · Cloud Infrastructure Basics for AI

eyebrow: Step one: turn on an identity
caption: Enabling a system-assigned managed identity while creating a VM — one checkbox, no secret issued to anyone (red box is Microsoft's own doc annotation).
The resource's own Identity blade — Status set to On is the managed identity actually existing in Microsoft Entra ID.

eyebrow: What that identity is allowed to reach
caption: The Key Vault this identity will be granted access to — secrets, keys, and certificates, never hardcoded in app code.

eyebrow: What the app's code never contains
code:
# Without managed identity
client = SecretClient(vault_url, credential=ClientSecretCredential(...))

# With managed identity
client = SecretClient(vault_url, credential=DefaultAzureCredential())
caption: Same SDK call, no client secret anywhere in the code, the config, or an environment variable.
